verdicts_or_reports.expected: With "Folder first" unchecked, folders are sorted by name together with files (Zeta should appear after the files, e.g. after todo.txt).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After unchecking "Folder first" and choosing Name, the list still puts folder Zeta first, directly under "..", above all files.
steps: Open Documents (notebook folder) in the file browser
Tap Sort by, untick 'Folder first', select 'Name' (Reverse order unticked), tap OK
Observe the list: Zeta (folder) is still the first item after '..', above Indent2.md etc.

harness_replies: Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes: I am signing off with one bug filed, so this PASS is not a clean bill of health. Coverage: (1) Sort: Size, Date, Name, reverse, and Folder-first toggles. The directory-grouping bug was reported: with "Folder first" unticked, folder Zeta stays above all files under Name and Date sort. Folder-first on still groups correctly. (2) Editor Duplicate (Ctrl+D) on the first, middle-ish and last lines, and on a single line without a trailing newline, all produced correct results. Undo restored each file. (3) Search/Replace: search count, Replace all, Replace (1), Undo after each, and empty search/replace fields. The replace field sits below the search field as intended. (4) View mode: plain text, nested list rendering, and rotation (state kept). Not covered or only partly covered: Move line up/down, the MIME type and Folder local sort options, Preserve Case, Match Case / Whole Word / regex toggles, the middle-line Duplicate case (keyboard interference prevented a clean retest), and sort persistence across app restart. No file was saved; all test edits were undone and the Save button was disabled on each file I left.
